title: Date poll
description: Propose a few days and see which suits your guests. You choose in the end.
noCapacity: Votes are opinions only: they never reserve a place.

add.title: Add a day
add.label: Proposed day
add.hint: Add one day at a time, 12 at most.

empty.title: You have not proposed any day yet
empty.body: Add the first day. Each household can vote Yes, Maybe or No on its invitation link.

confirm.title: Choose the day
confirm.body: When you choose a day, we first show you what moves with the date. Nothing changes until you confirm.

confirmed.title: The date is set: {date}
confirmed.body: Guests see it on their invitation link.

again.title: A new poll
again.body: If the date has to be decided again, propose other days.

errors.tooManyDates: You can propose 12 days at most.
errors.closed: The poll has ended. No more votes are taken.

guest.title: When suits you?
guest.intro: The host is choosing the date together with the guests. Tell us which days work for you — a vote reserves nothing.
guest.saved: Your votes are noted. Thank you!
